title: Promotional Financing and Door Bundle Credits
content:
# Promotional Financing and Door Bundle Credits

Window Replacement Contracts — bundle rate for a window and door pair financed through Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing.

**Rule.** A financing account is read only while it is in force, that is approved, active, delinquent or paid off; a cancelled or charged-off account is never read, and a contract with no account in force counts as not financed on a promotional plan. The bundle rate is multiplied by a promotional-financing share: when either contract of the pair is financed on a Ridgeline plan with a deferred-interest promotion, the deferred-interest share of 0.5; otherwise, when either is financed on a zero-interest equal-payment plan, the equal-payment share of 0.75; otherwise a share of one.

The pair is the window contract and its paired door contract; each is read through its own financing account in force. The share multiplies the bundle rate in full, that is the window series bundle percentage together with every amount added to it, before the rate is applied to the amount the credit is figured on; the credit is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

| Window contract's plan in force | Door contract's plan in force | Share |
|---|---|---|
| Deferred-interest promotion | Any | 0.5 |
| Any | Deferred-interest promotion | 0.5 |
| Zero-interest equal-payment | Not deferred-interest | 0.75 |
| Not deferred-interest | Zero-interest equal-payment | 0.75 |
| No promotion, or no account in force | No promotion, or no account in force | 1 |

## Hypothetical reading

A window contract on a zero-interest equal-payment plan and a door contract whose deferred-interest account was charged off: the door account is not read, so the share is 0.75.
